### **What’s New & Why It Matters**


-


**L-shaped design:**


Our new replacement system is a unique L-shape designed so that (when installed as directed) the camera, outlet, and connectors sit more than 3 feet from your baby’s sleep area.


-


**Enclosed design:** Unlike other cable guards that simply lay flat on top of a camera cable, our system features an enclosed design that wraps around the cable and reduces safety risks if the guards were somehow able to become detached from the wall.


-


**Pre-routed & Easy to Install:** Don’t worry, this system also comes with the cable pre-routed through the guard for ease of installation. Just snap the pieces together, apply the extra-strong adhesive against the wall, and you’re good to go.


-


**ASTM-compliant:**


Our new system goes above and beyond the voluntary ASTM standards and is the only pre-threaded, enclosed cable guard in the category.


-


**No Cost:** Free for all existing Owlet camera users. All new purchases of Dream Sight™ and Dream Duo™ made on


[www.owletcare.com](http://www.owletcare.com/) will include the new system at no additional charge.


###


### **How To Get Your New Cable Guards**


1.


Open the Owlet Dream App and complete the safety check. This only applies to Owlet camera users. If you are an Owlet camera user and do not see the safety check in your Dream App, reach out to our customer service team via our


[Help Center.](https://support.owletcare.com/hc/en-us/categories/35593075823757)


2.


Order your replacement in the Dream App or through the Help Center chat. There’s no deadline!


That’s it! Once you receive your cable guards, install them right away. You can view our step-by-step installation instructions here:


###


### **Remember these rules of nursery cable safety:**


-


Keep all exposed or loose cables more than 3 feet from Baby’s sleeping area and out of reach.


-


Re-check your cable guards periodically, especially whenever you redecorate or rearrange furniture.


-


Remember, toddlers climb – so think about what they can reach from the crib, a dresser, or a chair.


-


Along with following cable safety instructions, always follow safe sleep guidance from the American Academy of Pediatrics (the ABCs of safe sleep): baby


A


lone, on their


B


ack, in a


C


rib or bassinet.


-


If a cable guard ever becomes loose or detached, never attempt to reattach it, as the adhesive could be less effective. Please reach out to our customer service team, and we will support you in getting a replacement!


### ****


**Important Safety Information:** Cable guards do not eliminate all risk and are not a substitute for safe cable placement or adult supervision. Always keep loose and unsecured cables more than 3 feet from your baby’s sleep area and out of reach, and follow the installation instructions and warnings included with your Owlet product(s).
